package_type.value: Heavy Duty Diesel Engine Oil Additive

intended_service.value: An engine oil additive for the formulation of Ultra High Performance Diesel (UHPD) lubricants meeting the requirements of ACEA E6 and MB- Approval 228.51. A Lubrizol ACT™ product | Application: Diesel engines meeting Euro I, II, III, IV, V & VI emission requirements and running under severe operating conditions. Suitable for use with NOx reduction systems and particulate filters and designed for use in combination with low sulfur diesel fuel (maximum 50 ppm).
